H1.rationale: Attacker-Specific DSG recorded 0 runtime consistency violations vs 22 for Generic Adaptive, and 0 premature recognition indicators vs 21 (Static) and 12 (Generic).

H2.rationale: Attacker-Specific DSG produced 36 meaningful synthetic interactions vs 15 (Static Honeypot) and 12 (Generic Adaptive) across 9 held-out attack scenarios (Wilcoxon paired p=0.015625).

H3.rationale: In-process DSG planning + 7-way consistency validation + loopback /internal/mutate adds 0.1105 ms per adaptation event (vs 0 ms for Static and 0.1191 ms for Generic), shifting median step latency by +0.0131 ms and p95 by +0.116 ms. Across 131 steps, fast in-process loopback execution keeps absolute CPU overhead low, whereas live Docker /exec + PostgreSQL persistence incurs multi-millisecond/multi-second cost (measured separately).
